title: Carrot & Sweet Potato Lentil Stew
description: A thick, filling one-pot stew with tender carrots, sweet potato, and lentils in savory broth.

ingredients.item: dry brown or green lentils, rinsed
medium sweet potato, peeled and diced

steps.text: Simmer until the lentils and orange vegetables are tender.
Let it thicken briefly before serving.

cookSteps.text: Add {{lentils}} lentils, {{sweetpotato}} sweet potato, {{carrots}} carrots, {{broth}} broth, {{garlic}} garlic powder, and {{thyme}} thyme to a large pot. Season lightly with salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil, reduce to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook until lentils and vegetables are tender, about 30–35 minutes.
Uncover and simmer 5 minutes if you want it thicker. Taste and adjust seasoning.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.

title: Creamy Butternut & White Bean Pot
description: Soft butternut squash and creamy white beans make a hearty, spoonable one-pot supper without needing meat.

ingredients.item: peeled cubed butternut squash, fresh or frozen

steps.text: Add beans and mash a little squash to make the pot creamy.
Finish with milk and warm through.

cookSteps.text: Add {{squash}} butternut squash, {{broth}} broth, {{garlic}} garlic powder, and {{herb}} sage or thyme to a large pot.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer until squash is very tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in {{beans}} white beans. Mash some of the squash against the side of the pot with a spoon to thicken the broth, then simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in {{milk}} milk and heat gently for 3–5 minutes. Do not boil hard after adding milk. Season to taste.

title: Pumpkin Chickpea Curry Pot
description: A mild, creamy pumpkin-and-chickpea one-pot meal that is filling over rice or good by itself with bread.

steps.text: Combine pumpkin, coconut milk, broth, and seasoning.
Add chickpeas and simmer until thick.

cookSteps.text: Add {{pumpkin}} pumpkin puree, {{coconut}} coconut milk, {{broth}} broth, and {{curry}} mild curry powder to a pot and whisk until smooth.
Stir in {{chickpeas}} chickpeas. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered until thick and hot, about 15–20 minutes.
If using, stir in {{spinach}} frozen spinach and cook until hot, about 5 minutes. Taste and season with salt.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.

title: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Chili
description: A thick tomato chili packed with sweet potato and black beans for an inexpensive, filling one-pot dinner.

ingredients.item: medium sweet potatoes, peeled and diced

steps.text: Simmer until the sweet potatoes are tender.

cookSteps.text: Add {{sweetpotatoes}} sweet potatoes, {{beans}} black beans, {{tomatoes}} crushed tomatoes, {{broth}} broth, {{chili}} chili powder, and {{cumin}} cumin to a large pot.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer until sweet potatoes are tender, about 25–30 minutes.
Uncover and simmer 5–10 minutes until the chili is as thick as you like. Season to taste.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.

title: Carrot, Potato & Chicken One-Pot Stew
description: A simple savory chicken stew with plenty of sweet carrots and potatoes, made entirely in one pot.

ingredients.item: boneless chicken, cut into small pieces

steps.text: Simmer chicken and vegetables together in seasoned broth.
Cook until chicken is safe and vegetables are tender.
Mash a few potatoes into the broth for a thicker stew if desired.

cookSteps.text: Add {{chicken}} chicken, {{carrots}} carrots, {{potatoes}} potatoes, {{broth}} chicken broth, {{garlic}} garlic powder, and {{thyme}} thyme to a large pot.
Bring to a boil, reduce to a steady simmer, cover, and cook until vegetables are tender and chicken reaches 165°F, about 25–30 minutes.
For a thicker stew, mash several potato pieces against the side of the pot and stir them back in. Simmer uncovered 5 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato & Red Lentil Pottage
description: A thick, comforting pottage where red lentils soften into the broth around tender pieces of sweet potato and carrot.

ingredients.item: large sweet potato, peeled and diced

steps.text: Put lentils, orange vegetables, broth, and seasonings in one pot.
Simmer until soft and naturally thick.
Adjust with a splash of broth if needed.

cookSteps.text: Add {{lentils}} red lentils, {{sweetpotato}} sweet potato, {{carrots}} carrots, {{broth}} broth, {{garlic}} garlic powder, and {{thyme}} thyme to a large pot.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover loosely, and simmer until lentils have softened and vegetables are tender, about 25–30 minutes. Stir occasionally.
Stir well to make the pottage thick and creamy while leaving some vegetable pieces intact. Add a splash of broth if it gets thicker than you like.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.
